rows.note: Use this all-purpose everyday word when the sentiment means a general thought, view, or opinion rather than an emotion.

example.english: I think this sentiment is quite practical.
example.traditional: 我覺得呢個諗法幾實際。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 nam2 faat3 gei2 sat6 zai3

rows.note: Use this when sentiment means the feeling or impression someone has, rather than their stated view.

example.english: That song left me with a very special sentiment about this memory.
example.traditional: 聽完嗰首歌，我對呢段回憶有種好特別嘅感受。
example.jyutping: teng1 jyun4 go2 sau2 go1 ngo5 deoi3 ni1 dyun6 wui4 jik1 jau5 zung2 hou2 dak6 bit6 ge3 gam2 sau6

rows.note: Use this for tender or emotional feelings, especially when they are contrasted with reason or judgment.

example.english: You can't make decisions based only on sentiment.
example.traditional: 做決定唔可以淨係靠感情。
example.jyutping: zou6 kyut3 ding6 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 kaau3 gam2 cing4
